  "edit": {"MATRIX_LR": 0.15},
  "description": "MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.15 combined with kept WARMUP_RATIO=0.05",
  "report_to_operator": "Possible data leakage: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' would include shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD (the val split). Their 1.104 -> 0.958 gain looks too large for +10% data and is consistent with training on the eval set. Please confirm the intended train/val shard split before the team adopts '0-10'."
